## What this page will contain

A single table will map "your situation" to the matching chapter in one of
the seven verified external textbooks. Your situation is defined by
`stat_goal` and `design`, using the same controlled vocabulary as the
prompt-library schema in `prompts/_schema.yaml`. Each row carries its own
license tag:

| Textbook | License |
|---|---|
| psyteachr data-skills | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| psyteachr analysis | CC BY 4.0 |
| psyteachr stat-models | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| psyteachr quant-fun | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| psyteachr reprores | CC BY |
| lsj-book (Foxcroft / Navarro) | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| bradduthie/stats | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (link only, no excerpting) |

This page is English-only. The source textbooks are all in English. Its table
will be generated from the `links` field of each prompt-library entry
(`prompts/entries/*.yaml`), so the mapping stays maintained in one place.
That generation step is not built yet, so this page currently carries only
the source list above.
